==Standard dialogue==
* '''Doomsayer:''' Dooooom!
* '''Player:''' Where?
* '''Doomsayer:''' All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
* '''Player:''' Is there anything we can do about this doom?
* '''Doomsayer:''' There is nothing you need to do my friend, for I am the Doomsayer! I roam the world sensing danger.
* '''Doomsayer:''' If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|I'd like to get rid of some of your warning signs.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd like to get rid of some of your warning signs.
** '''Doomsayer:''' Oh... Very well.
** {{tact|Reset Warning Messages interface opens}}
* {{topt|Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning signs.}}
** {{tmissing}}

===Subsequent times===
* '''Doomsayer:''' Dooooom!
* {{tselect|Select an option}}
* {{topt|I'd like to get rid of some of your warning signs.}}
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|I'd better be off.}}
** '''Player:''' I'd better be off.
** {{tact|end}}

==Treasure Trails==
===Easy===
* '''Doomsayer:''' You got lucky this time, next time doom will be upon you.
* {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (easy) detail.png|You've been given another clue!}}
** {{tact|receives=an [[Clue scroll (easy)|easy clue scroll]]}}
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (easy) detail.png|You've obtained a casket!}}
** {{tact|receives=an [[Reward casket (easy)|easy reward casket]]}}
** {{tact|end}}

===Hard===
* '''Doomsayer:''' Ah! Here you go!
* '''Player:''' What?
* '''Doomsayer:''' I need you to answer this for me.
* {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|The Doomsayer has given you a challenge scroll!}}
* {{tact|receives=a [[Challenge_scroll#Hard|challenge scroll]]}}
* {{tact|end}}

====When spoken to again====
* '''Doomsayer:''' Please enter the answer to the question.
* {{tcond|When given the wrong answer:}}
** '''Doomsayer:''' How can that be? Try again!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|When given the correct answer:}}
** '''Doomsayer:''' Spot on!
** {{tcond|When given another clue scroll:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Clue scroll (hard) detail.png|The Doomsayer has given you another clue scroll!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard clue scroll]]}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|When given a reward casket:}}
*** {{tbox|pic=Reward casket (hard) detail.png|you've obtained a casket!}}
*** {{tact|receives=a [[Reward casket (hard)|hard reward casket]]}}
*** {{tact|end}}

==Historical dialogue==
* '''Doomsayer:''' Dooooom!
* '''Player:''' Where?
* '''Doomsayer:''' All around us! I can feel it in the air, hear it on the wind, smell it... also in the air!
* '''Player:''' Is there anything we can do about this doom?
* '''Doomsayer:''' There is nothing you need to do my friend! I am the Doomsayer, although my real title could be something like the Danger Tutor.
* '''Player:''' Danger Tutor?
* '''Doomsayer:''' Yes! I roam the world sensing danger.
* '''Doomsayer:''' If you see the signs often enough, then you can turn them off; by that time you likely know what the area has in store for you.
* '''Doomsayer:''' If I find a dangerous area, then I put up warning signs that will tell you what is so dangerous about that area.
* '''Player:''' But what if I want to see the warnings again?
* '''Doomsayer:''' That's why I'm waiting here!
* '''Doomsayer:''' If you want to see the warning messages again, I can turn them back on for you.
* {{tcond|If the player hasn't disabled any warnings:}}
** '''Player:''' Thanks, I'll remember that if I see any warning messages.
** '''Doomsayer:''' You're welcome!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has disabled some warnings:}}
** '''Doomsayer:''' Do you need to turn on any warnings right now?
** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|Yes, I do.}}
*** '''Player:''' Yes, I do.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|Not right now.}}
*** '''Player:''' Not right now.
*** '''Doomsayer:''' Ok, keep an eye out for the messages though!
*** '''Player:''' I will.
*** {{tact|end}}
